title: Carried over: oldest stone tools
summary: Human relatives knock sharp flakes off stones. The oldest claimed tools (Lomekwi 3, Kenya, c. 3.3 million years ago) are debated; Oldowan tools follow from c. 2.9 million years ago (Nyayanga, Kenya).
why: The oldest known stone tools: the start of the human toolkit.

notes.problem: Lomekwi (Kenya) conflated with Oldowan (Ethiopia); descent claim unsupported
